creator: Alexander Terp
description: 2026-10-04 review (plausible): app_lock.rs exchange counts any failure after connect as Sent. If the app accepts into its backlog and quits, the write succeeds and the read gets EOF/ECONNRESET, so the launch errors out with no window where it used to retry and take the lock. Treat EOF with no reply byte as unsent. Also speculative from the same review: adoption keyed by bare file name can rename an old window-2.toml over a new one (needs an old process that refused to quit).
title: Handover: an app that quits after accepting the connection makes the launch give up
